subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the bracketed word in the sentence given below.

Surrounded by lush greenery, the house stood __________ (submissively) atop a hill.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Proudly)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Submissively"** means showing a willingness to obey or follow someone else’s authority without resistance. (आज्ञाकारी रूप से)

 
 
• **Example:** The child nodded submissively when asked to apologise for her mistake.
 
 
 
• **"Proudly"** refers to showing confidence, self-respect, or satisfaction in one’s achievements, status, or possessions. It is the opposite of being submissive, as it suggests a sense of dignity and self-assertion. (गर्वपूर्वक)
 
 
• **Example:** He proudly displayed his medals on the shelf for everyone to see.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **"submissively"** is **"proudly"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (Proudly)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sturdily** (मज़बूती से): In a way that is strong, firm, or solid.

 
 
• **Example:** The chair was sturdily built to withstand heavy weights.
 
 
 
• **Deftly** (चतुराई से): In a skillful, quick, or clever way.
 
 
• **Example:** She deftly wove the threads into a beautiful tapestry.
 
 
 
• **Magically** (जादुई रूप से): In a way that seems enchanting, extraordinary, or supernatural.
 
 
• **Example:** The view from the mountain was magically breathtaking.
